Food and opened drinks need to be consumed away from cards. if you have a bottle with a cap, you may have it with you as long as it is sealed between drinks. Keep all hands to ourselves, and away from other people's items and cards unless given permission. 

No squabbles, any disagreements should be brought to the attention of the person in charge.  Excitement is good! But disruptive behavior is not, please refrain from shouting over others.

Join us for our official Play! Pokémon TCG Challenge.

Event Schedule

5:00 PM – Doors Open / Player Check-In
Players can begin arriving, checking in and submitting their completed deck lists.

6:00 PM – Registration Closes
All players should be checked in and ready to play by this time.

6:00–6:15 PM – Deck List & Player Checks
Final Player ID, registration and deck-list checks before pairings are created.

Approximately 6:15 PM – Round 1 Begins

Further rounds will follow immediately after the previous round finishes, with pairings announced in-store.

The exact number of Swiss rounds will depend on attendance.

Please Remember
A Play! Pokémon Player ID is required.
Bring a legal Standard-format Pokémon TCG deck.
Bring a completed deck list matching the deck you will use.
Please arrive by 6:00 PM at the latest.
Players arriving after registration has closed may not be able to participate.

Official deck list:
https://play.pokemon.com/en-gb/resources/documents/?filter=tcg

We look forward to seeing everyone for a great evening of competitive Pokémon TCG!
